trigger: RCA-2026-05-13-content-drift-detected-at-tz-mislabel.md Phase 1 fix proposal touches cloud_sync transmit path (content_drift_events column semantics)

questions.name: Atomic primitives
questions.question: Are writes to content_drift_events + cloud_sync push atomic with respect to each other (no torn read between INSERT and SELECT)?
questions.evidence: content_drift.rs:289-298 INSERT runs in default sqlx transaction; cloud_sync_payload.rs:376-385 SELECT WHERE detected_at > ? runs in separate connection with its own snapshot. SQLite WAL-mode provides snapshot isolation between concurrent reader/writer. No partial writes observed in 36,199 row history.

questions.name: TTL-bounded sentinels
questions.question: Does cloud_sync push have TTL-bounded retry/dedup sentinels so a stuck push doesn't stall indefinitely or duplicate forever?
questions.evidence: cloud_sync_payload.rs uses last_push cursor (WHERE detected_at > ?) — implicit dedup via monotonic timestamp ordering. NO explicit TTL on the cursor itself; if cursor write fails, next sync retries from same point (idempotent). However: TZ-mislabel may corrupt cursor semantics if a fix-forward writes correct UTC values that sort BEFORE the legacy IST-labeled cursor (5h30m gap). Mitigation: backfill (RCA Phase 1 Option A) restores monotonic order.
questions.concern: Cursor semantics fragile across the TZ-fix transition. Need explicit ordering guarantee in fix PR.

questions.name: Behavioral verify (binary hash / ws_uptime / mtime — NOT echo string)
questions.question: After cloud_sync push, does the system verify Bono VPS actually persisted the rows (not just '200 OK' from the relay)?
questions.evidence: cloud_sync.rs / cloud_sync_payload.rs — no read-back from Bono after push. tracing::info!('Cloud sync push: {} content_drift_events') logs the COUNT pushed, not the count CONFIRMED on the Bono side. This is the proxy-vs-behavior anti-pattern (CGP H3 'health 200 != fix works' class).
questions.concern: Cannot verify post-fix that corrected timestamps reach Bono — we'd be trusting the push log only.

questions.name: Single-target dry-run path
questions.question: Can we test the cloud_sync fix on a single pod's drift events (not fleet-wide) before all 8 pods write the corrected format?
questions.evidence: content_drift.rs:282 fix is server-side (Server .23) — affects all pods immediately on next 60-min cycle. BUT: per RCA Phase 1 ordering, deploy to Server .23 only (single deploy target), wait 1 cycle, verify next batch of inserts shows correct +00:00 label vs +05:30 wall-time mapping. Pods are NOT touched by this fix — they only serve /debug/content-dirs (no timestamp involvement on pod side).

questions.name: Guards have written contracts with delivery script
questions.question: Does any guard / pre-commit / hook block the timestamp anti-pattern, with a parser-not-regex and allowlist contract?
questions.evidence: No clippy lint, no pre-commit hook, no PreToolUse hook for the `Utc::now() + Duration::hours(5) + Duration::minutes(30)` anti-pattern. CLAUDE.md has a TZ warning for shell scripts only. RCA Phase 3 proposes adding this gate. Without the gate, the same anti-pattern can re-enter via future PRs.
questions.concern: Soft-rule only. Sibling-of network-map-IP-rule pre-go-live escalation pattern (text-only memo carries >=1 repeat-violation/30d per project_s146_enforcement_rca_20260510.md).

verdict: FAIL — 3/5 PARTIAL or NO. Triggers infrastructure-side §S-146 RCA on cloud_sync surface BEFORE the content_drift TZ fix proceeds.

blocking_concerns.summary: Q3 NO behavioral verify — proceeding with TZ fix means we can't confirm Bono receives corrected timestamps
blocking_concerns.blocks: RCA Phase 1 Option B (backfill bundled with code fix) — without read-back, backfill might silently fail on Bono mirror

blocking_concerns.summary: Q5 NO enforcement gate — fix-forward can be undone by future PR
blocking_concerns.blocks: Long-term durability of the fix; mitigation is RCA Phase 3 hook addition

blocking_concerns.summary: Q2 PARTIAL cursor semantics — last_push cursor straddles TZ-fix boundary
blocking_concerns.blocks: Backfill order matters — must complete before any new writes use corrected format, else cursor logic skips rows

recommended_path: Captain auth path (D) from RCA: escalate to MMA Step 1 DIAGNOSE on cloud_sync surface itself. Concretely — author cloud_sync §S-146 RCA covering Q3 behavioral-verify gap + Q2 cursor-fragility + Q5 enforcement-gap, THEN proceed to content_drift Phase 1 fix.
